Stratagems

Stratagems
  Helldivers 2   Helldivers 1    
Looking for something that isn't here? Check out Category:Stratagems for all Stratagem related articles.

Stratagems are powerful ordnance, utilities and equipment available to The Helldivers, provided to them by their Super Destroyers. They are considered to be the most powerful tool in a Helldiver's arsenal.

Overview

Usage

Stratagems are deployed by Helldivers by entering a unique code. By opening the stratagem menu (CTRL on PC) and correctly entering the code, Helldivers will, in most cases, need to throw a stratagem ball to direct the target area for the Super Destroyer. Incorrectly entering a section of the code, or closing the stratagem menu, will require Helldivers to re-enter the code until it is correct.

Acquisition

Stratagems are unlocked in three ways: by purchasing them in the Patriotic Administration Center, by purchasing them from Warbonds, and occasionally as rewards from Major Orders and Campaigns.

Some stratagems may also occasionally be temporarily provided in certain missions, as part of a mission objective, or through temporary permits issued by High Command in the form of a "Weapons Augmentation."

Stratagem Types

Stratagems have a variety of purposes, but can be separated into four primary categories (denoted by their permit type and icon color): Offensive (Red), Supply (Blue), Defensive (Green), and Mission (Yellow).

  • Offensive stratagems are primarily used to destroy large amounts of enemies or very large enemies. Different stratagems are more effective than one another in these different roles. For example, the Orbital Gatling Barrage is more suited to dealing with large groups of smaller enemies (such as Troopers, Scavengers, and Voteless), while the Orbital Railcannon Strike is best used against single, massive targets (such as Bile Titans, Vox Engines, and Harvesters). Most offensive stratagems can also be used to destroy enemy structures, such as Fabricators, Spore Spewers, and Rogue Research Stations.
    • Offensive stratagems come in two primary categories: Orbital Strikes and Eagle Strikes.
  • Supply stratagems are equipment that is used to boost an individual Helldiver's capabilities against enemies. This is often in the form of portable heavy weapons, supporting gear, and vehicles.
    • Supply stratagems come in three primary categories: Support Weapons, Backpacks, and Vehicles.
  • Defensive stratagems are more suited for creating an effective defensive posture against oncoming enemies. Defensive stratagems are typically used to supplement a Helldiver's firepower against approaching enemies, whether coming from a reinforcement call or by protecting a Main Objective.
    • Defensive stratagems come in two primary categories: Sentries and Emplacements.
  • Mission stratagems are unique in that they are not often used to supplement Helldivers or destroy enemies, but rather to complete mission objectives. Some mission stratagems will always be available to Helldivers (such as Reinforce & Resupply) while others will be mission-specific, often requiring Helldivers to be in a certain area before they are able to be called-in.

List of Stratagems

The following stratagems are found in Helldivers 2. Helldivers can select up to four different stratagems when defining their loadout for a Mission.

Offensive Permit

Orbital Strikes Orbital strikes take longer to call-in, but are often more powerful and reach a wider area than Eagle strikes. Orbital strikes are best used against a slow and predictable force, such as an unaware enemy patrol, or a Bug Breach. Orbital strikes will go on cooldown immediately after they make contact with the surface. In Cities and Factories, a Super Destroyer may need to reposition to accurately fire an orbital strike, this can further increase call-in time.

Eagle Strikes Eagle strikes are faster to call in and have multiple uses before going on cooldown, but often cover a smaller area than orbital strikes. Eagle strikes function as a much more on-demand response to apparent threats. When called-in, an Eagle aircraft will drop its payload perpendicular to where a Helldiver threw the stratagem ball (With the exceptions of the Eagle Strafing Run & Eagle 500kg Bomb, which will drop it's payload parallel to where a Helldiver threw the stratagem ball). When all of its payload is expended, an Eagle will automatically go on cooldown to rearm. This can also be done at any time by Helldivers when an Eagle has less than 100% of its payload by entering the Eagle Rearm code.

Supply Permit

Support Weapons Support weapons are heavy weapons that are designed to augment an individual Helldiver's firepower against enemies. Like offensive stratagems, support weapons have different utilities and are intended for facing different enemies. Some support weapons (such as the MG-43 Machine Gun) allow Helldivers to better deal with groups of light-medium enemies, while others (such as the GR-8 Recoilless Rifle) allow Helldivers to destroy large-massive enemies. Certain support weapons (such as the AC-8 Autocannon) require Helldivers to carry an ammunition backpack to reload the weapon. If an ally is nearby, they can interact with the backpack to provide crew-loading, massively increasing the reload speed of the weapon.

Backpacks Backpacks are typically used in a more supportive role for Helldivers. Ranging from additional firepower in the form of Guard Dog drones, to mobility tools and other supporting options. It is only recommended to bring a backpack when a Helldiver is not already bringing a support weapon that requires a backpack for reloading.

Vehicles Vehicles consist of Fast Recon Vehicles (FRVs), Exosuits, and the Bastion. FRVs are reconnaissance vehicles that come equipped with mounted weapons and are able to carry multiple Helldivers at a time, used to quickly maneuver around a mission area. Exousits are single-piloted mechsuits that have increased armor and a variety of mounted weapons, meant to destroy a large amount of enemies while clearing a path for allies. The Bastion is a four-man armored tank destroyer.

Defensive Permit

Sentries Sentries are automated weapon turrets that come with a limited supply of ammo and will automatically engage enemies when in range. Sentries are outfitted with a variety of different weaponry for different purposes, including machine guns, autocannons, mortars, and even rockets. A Helldiver's choice of sentry should change depending on their playstyle, current loadout, as well as the expected enemy force. Sentry turrets are best used to fill the gap in a Helldiver's defense, covering one or more areas that would be impossible for a Helldiver to cover by themselves.

Emplacements Emplacements are other defensive stratagems that can range from deployable minefields to mounted weapon platforms. Minefields (and the A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower) fill a similar role to sentries, providing cover to an area without requiring Helldiver attention. Alternatively, mounted weapon platforms are emplacements operated by Helldivers, providing a significant boost in firepower in exchange for sacrificing all mobility.
